question: "Dreams From My Father" is an autobiography of ________
solution:
The correct answer is __**Barack Obama**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Dreams From My Father is an autobiography of Barack Obama, the **44th President of the United States**.
 
• The book explores Obama's early life, from his childhood in Hawaii to his years as a community organizer in** Chicago**. 
 
• It also delves into his complex racial identity, as the son of a** black Kenyan father and a white American mother**.
